text:
eva: Heads up  I'm preparing a small docs PR to cover a few on-prem installer edge cases: BusyBox-based hosts, systemd tmpfiles.d for /var/run paths, and a PKCS#11 socket hardening checklist for airgapped installs. Tagging @mike for tmpfiles snippet and @neel for HSM PKCS11 notes.

mike: Ack. For BusyBox systems we should call out that `update-alternatives` might be unavailable and offer `iptables-save`/`nft list ruleset` examples. Also a tmpfiles.d snippet to ensure /var/run/redwood exists on boot: `/etc/tmpfiles.d/redwood.conf` with `d /var/run/redwood 0750 root redwoodhsm -`

neel: For HSMs: document group ownership and socket perms, and add a short PKCS11 check command. Also call out that some vendor middleware uses `/run` vs `/var/run` and that admins should check both.

tara: Can we include a tiny SDK note: when the SDK opens a unix socket path, show an example of configuring `REDWOOD_KMS_SOCKET=/var/run/redwood/kms.sock` and a fallback to TCP for private installs that can't use unix sockets? Keeps apps from failing on boot.

neel: small nit: prefer `redwoodhsm` group in examples; mention mapping to an existing group if org policy requires.

mike: Draft tmpfiles and systemd unit snippet below, will add to PR under Private installer -> Filesystem & Services:

mike: ```ini
# /etc/tmpfiles.d/redwood.conf
# ensure runtime dir at boot
d /var/run/redwood 0750 root redwoodhsm -
```

mike: ```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/redwood-kms.service.d/10-resources.conf
[Service]
User=redwoodsvc
Group=redwoodhsm
LimitNOFILE=65536
Slice=redwood.slice
```

neel: PKCS11 checklist draft:
- create /var/lib/redwood/hsm owned root:redwoodhsm 0750
- place PKCS11 lib in /opt/hsm and verify vendor checksum
- socket under /var/run/redwood with 0660 and group redwoodhsm
- avoid symlinks into /tmp or user-writable paths

neel: PKCS11 quick test: `sudo -u redwoodsvc bash -c 'ls -l /var/run/redwood || true; test -w /var/run/redwood/kms.sock && echo SOCKET_OK'`

secops-bot: Security note: include distro package names for semanage fallbacks (RHEL: policycoreutils-python-utils, Fedora: policycoreutils; Debian/Ubuntu: selinux-basics + selinux-utils alternatives). Also recommend documenting `restorecon` use but not to recommend disabling SELinux.

eva: Great. I'll bundle the tmpfiles, systemd drop-in, SDK env fallback, and PKCS11 checklist into one compact PR and ask for secops sign-off. Will also add a link fix to the installer preflight page (noticed the old URL in the current doc).

docs-bot: CI queued for branch eva/tmpfiles-pkcs11-fixes. Preview link will appear here after build.

eva: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4470  small docs-only change. Please review and flag anything missing.

mike: LGTM, left one inline about BusyBox limitations.

neel: Approved for HSM content. Added a short sentence about vendor middleware placing sockets in `/run/vendorname`.

secops-bot: Security review: cleared with low-risk. Merge after CI passes.

eva: Thanks all  merging once preview expires.
